items: Depop ends independent shipping on new listings. Since Oct. 28, all new US Depop listings must use Depop Shipping through USPS. Listings set to "Other" before that date keep independent shipping until they sell.

FedEx adds paid Authenticated Delivery option. The new upgrade is available in the U.S. and Canada, alongside Tracking+, Returns+ and a Global Trade Navigator suite. FedEx's announcement does not state a change to base rates.

EU now requires product IDs on low-value B2C imports. DHL said Product Identifiers became mandatory on Nov. 1 for B2C shipments valued up to EUR 150 entering the EU27, with a Merchant PID and a Non-Standardized Manufacturer PID per line item. Missing data may cause clearance delays, holds or return-to-origin.
